name: infinite-canvas
description: Inspect, edit, and run the active Infinite Canvas browser canvas from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to an authenticated Infinite Canvas browser session. Inspect snapshots, create or update nodes and edges, and start existing workflow execution without bypassing canvasStore.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my active Infinite Canvas and summarize its workflow.
Add and connect nodes on my active Infinite Canvas.
Run selected nodes and monitor the execution.
